name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
